SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B JOIN BOARD_TYPE BT ON B.BOARD_TYPE_NO = BT.BOARD_TYPE_NO WHERE BT.BOARD_TYPE_CODE = 'NOTICE' AND B.BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N'
AND B.BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'

SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_CONTENT, B.READ_COUNT, B.BOARD_DEL_FL, B.MEMBER_NO, TO_CHAR(B.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(B.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN BOARD_TYPE BT ON B.BOARD_TYPE_NO = BT.BOARD_TYPE_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND BT.BOARD_TYPE_CODE = 'NOTICE' AND B.BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B JOIN BOARD_TYPE BT ON B.BOARD_TYPE_NO = BT.BOARD_TYPE_NO WHERE BT.BOARD_TYPE_CODE = 'NOTICE'
AND B.BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, MEMBER_NO, BOARD_TYPE_NO) VALUES ( SEQ_BOARD_NO.NEXTVAL, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberNo}, (SELECT BOARD_TYPE_NO FROM BOARD_TYPE WHERE BOARD_TYPE_CODE = 'NOTICE') )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BOARD_TITLE = #{boardTitle}, BOARD_CONTENT = #{boardContent}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
